verdict.rationale: All documentation in the pack describes the consumer Gemini Apps (chat, image gen, Deep Research, Gems, connected apps) with no mention of a documented public API, SDK, or endpoints for driving Gemini programmatically. The runtime probe explicitly confirms no llms.txt or MCP/agent-docs surface on gemini.google.com and notes that the developer API lives on a separate product (ai.google.dev), which is out of scope for this evidence pack.
